mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question ( quiz_id, question_type, question_text, question_image, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, reference_answer, explanation, marks, topic ) VALUES ( #{quizId}, #{questionType}, #{questionText}, #{questionImage}, #{optionA}, #{optionB}, #{optionC}, #{optionD}, #{correctOption}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{explanation}, #{marks}, #{topic} )
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET question_type = #{questionType}, question_text = #{questionText}, question_image = #{questionImage}, option_a = #{optionA}, option_b = #{optionB}, option_c = #{optionC}, option_d = #{optionD}, correct_option = #{correctOption}, reference_answer = #{referenceAnswer}, explanation = #{explanation}, marks = #{marks}, topic = #{topic}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT question_id, quiz_id, question_type, question_text, question_image, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, reference_answer, explanation, marks, topic, created_at, updated_at FROM question WHERE question_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT question_id, quiz_id, question_type, question_text, question_image, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, reference_answer, explanation, marks, topic, created_at, updated_at FROM question WHERE question_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT question_id, quiz_id, question_type, question_text, question_image, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, reference_answer, explanation, marks, topic FROM question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY question_id ASC

SELECT q.question_id, q.quiz_id, q.question_type, q.question_text, q.question_image, q.option_a, q.option_b, q.option_c, q.option_d, sa.selected_option, sa.answer_text, sa.answer_image, COALESCE(sa.answer_status, 'UNANSWERED') AS answer_status,
q.correct_option, q.reference_answer, q.explanation, sa.is_correct, sa.awarded_marks,
NULL AS correct_option, NULL AS reference_answer, NULL AS explanation, NULL AS is_correct, NULL AS awarded_marks,
q.marks, q.topic FROM question q LEFT JOIN student_answer sa ON sa.question_id = q.question_id AND sa.attempt_id = #{attemptId} WHERE q.quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY q.question_id ASC

SELECT question_id, quiz_id, question_type, question_text, question_image, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_option, reference_answer, explanation, marks, topic, created_at, updated_at FROM question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY question_id ASC
